product_one_liner.value: Owl.co provides AI-powered claims intelligence that turns claim documents and external records into structured, cited evidence for insurance claims, investigation, and legal teams.

pricing_page.notes: No public plans or pricing page was found; enterprise fees are set in individual order forms.

named_customers.notes: Named logos appear under “In production at” on the homepage.

founded_year.notes: Owl’s own article and company-issued funding release state 2018; the LinkedIn company profile instead lists 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog indexes contain insurance/product thought leadership and company news, not at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation portal lists API reference, integrations, core concepts, security, model cards, and multiple implementation guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applying the requested title-based rule: current titles do not explicitly name AI, ML, machine learning, data science, or the other qualifying specialties; AI-focused responsibilities in software-engineering postings do not qualify.

model_provider.notes: Owl names its own model in the documentation’s model-card section. The homepage compares Owl with GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.6, but does not establish that OpenAI or Anthropic powers the product.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims include SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, plus HIPAA and GDPR compliance; the latter two are compliance regimes, not certifications in the same sense.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly listed round is November 2021, before the 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

launched_6mo.notes: The 2026-05-09 article introduces Template Assistant as a new feature integrating OwlAssist with OwlVision’s document generator; this dated announcement is on the inclusive start boundary of the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The public team page does not provide executive start dates, and the reviewed announcements and profiles did not establish a qualifying C-level or VP-level join or departure during the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive posting requires forecasting in Salesforce and maintaining CRM hygiene.
